caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with a reddish-brown wood grain finish. The cabinet has one drawer at the top, identifiable by a horizontal outline, with two round brass knobs. Below the drawer there is a rectangular cabinet door with a similar knob and brass-colored hinges on the right side. The cabinet stands on four turned legs, each featuring carved segments and ending in small, metal casters. The top of the cabinet has slightly curved, raised sides at the back and both the left and right edges, forming a partial enclosure. The overall composition centers the cabinet within a lightly sketched rectangular border, and the artist's name, "FRANCIS BORELLI," is inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Wash Stand
